events.summary: Speaker A set the project aim: design a new remote control that is original, trendy and user-friendly.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the project aim is to design a new remote control

events.summary: Speaker A gave the selling price of the remote as twenty five Euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: The selling price of our remote control is gonna be twenty five Euros

events.summary: Speaker A gave the profit aim as fifteen million Euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: And our profit aim is fifteen million Euros

events.summary: Speaker A set the production cost at a maximum of twelve Euro fifty per remote.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the production cost should be a maximum of twelve Euro fifty per remote control

events.summary: Speaker A decided the remote will be sold internationally, worldwide.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: The market range is international, so it's gonna be sold world-wide

events.summary: Speaker D proposed grouping the buttons by function, such as all text-function buttons in one area.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: all the buttons which apply to the text functions

events.summary: Speaker D proposed grouping the volume buttons together too.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: I think we should group them

events.summary: Speaker D proposed including functions for VCRs and DVD players and recorders, since TVs are used with them.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: I think it should be good to include functions for V_C_R_s and D_V_D_ players

events.summary: Speaker A objected that DVD players and home cinema sets often double as stereo hi-fi sets, so the remote may need that too.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the D_V_D_ players and home cinema sets often double as stereo hi-fi sets probably

events.summary: Speaker B objected that the remote is only for television, so VCR and DVD functions are not needed.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: So we probably don't have to have to uh have the functions for D_V_D_ player or V_C_R_

events.summary: Speaker A objected that most television remote controls support other functions as well.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: most television remote controls support other functions as well

events.summary: Speaker D objected that extra functions are not worth it, since no one would buy the remote for them.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: Yeah, also no one's gonna buy it

events.summary: Speaker A gave Speaker B the usability task, since making the remote very useful is an important point to excel on.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: this gonna be a very important task for you then

events.summary: Speaker A proposed adding extras such as a can opener underneath or an MP3 player inside.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Maybe a can opener underneath it

events.summary: Speaker A objected to the extras because they would probably make production costs too high.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: well then the production costs are gonna be too high probably

events.summary: Speaker B objected that the remote should be kept simple to reach a whole international market with a standard.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: we have to keep it simple, to get a whole market

events.summary: Speaker A proposed different types of fronts to make the remote special.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Maybe with different type of fronts or uh
